title: Fire
body:
Syntax: (no command of its own -- a personal trait revealed by channeling a Chakra Paper, see 'help channel')

Description: One of the five chakra natures (see 'help elements'). Fireball Jutsu (Ninjutsu, level 20) requires Fire to cast at all, and carries a real chance to set the target Burning -- steady HP damage each round for a few rounds.

Boosted in desert biomes. Weakened near open water (ocean, river, lake).

Date: 2026-08-26

Second nature choices at level 25:
Fire + Water: Boil Release (help boil release)
Fire + Wind: Scorch Release (help scorch release)
Fire + Earth: Lava Release (help lava release)
Fire + Lightning: Flashfire Release (help flashfire release)
